detail.longDescription: 🧰 FeedEcho 1.10 is out. Echo templates are now real, sandboxed Jinja2 instead of my old regex placeholder hack. Conditionals, filters, and the full item dict are available, plus a live Preview button that renders your template against the feed's three most recent items before you save it. No more guessing what a post will look like. Old templates keep working unchanged, and bad templates get rejected in the form instead of silently failing later. https:// github.com/jcrabapple/feedecho /releases/tag/v1.10.1 # selfhosted # rss # indieweb
